annotations.title: Find the evidence on a substance or a question

description: Use this when someone asks what a supplement, nutrient, drug, food compound or plant does in the body, or whether it affects something specific (for example "does magnesium help sleep?", "what is creatine shown to do?", "omega-3 and triglycerides"). Pass the substance (or an outcome such as "sleep") as query, and the specific effect, if there is one, as about. One call resolves the name to the node that has findings and returns them, each with its evidence strength in words, the study design, the quote, the paper, a permalink and a citation to quote as it stands. Without about, summary lists everything the node has findings about. If nothing matches, it says so: tell the person Catalyst has no findings on it rather than answering from memory as though from Catalyst. An evidence strength says how well the evidence supports a finding; it is not a recommendation.

about.description: Optional: the specific effect or outcome asked about (e.g. "sleep", "blood pressure"), or a node id.

detail.description: brief (default): each finding with its claim, evidence strength, design, population, dose, quote, paper, permalink and a ready-to-quote citation. full: every recorded field.

evidence_strength.description: Optional floor: only findings with at least this evidence strength.

limit.description: Findings to return, strongest evidence first.

query.description: The substance or outcome the person asked about, in their words (e.g. "magnesium", "vitamin D", "sleep"), or a node id.

name: find_evidence
title: Find the evidence on a substance or a question
